item.title: Phishing link to another site
item.description: This item points away from the feed's own site and must be skipped.

item.title: Script link
item.description: A link that runs code instead of opening a page must be skipped.

item.title: Lookalike host
item.description: A host that only starts with the right name is still another site.

item.title: Credentials in the link
item.description: Links carrying credentials are refused even on the right host.

item.title: From the far future
item.description: A publish date years ahead is a broken or hostile clock and is skipped.

item.title: No date
item.description: Without a date the seven-day rule cannot be applied, so the item is skipped.

item.title: Mario Kart gets new tracks
item.description: Four new tracks arrive next week, including one set on a giant birthday cake with candles to dodge.
